</Heading>

<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/cases/{caseId}/classify"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Send inline rows (at most 1,000 rows or 10 MB), rows.source upload (then send the file in blocks to upload/blocks/\{index\} and call commit), or record keys of the knowledge base (at most 10,000). The tree, memo and records table versions are pinned when the job starts.

>
